page.overview:
Who is Virfuril?

Virfuril was the fifteenth king of Aedirn and the father of Demavend III.

Around he defeated Medell's armies at Hagge, thereby strengthening his control of the Pontar Valley, and established the existing borders between Temeria and Aedirn. From this victory, Virfuril took the Amber Chamber as a spoil but which was later lost in the storm of war, it was either buried or destroyed.
